sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 per unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for sharing your data regarding our delivery performance and your volume forecast. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As to the delivery record and price history and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. To accommodate your request for 90-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of €4.94 per unit. This valid Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your flexibility in adjusting the payment terms to 60 days and extending the contract to 36 months. Based on these revised terms, we can offer a unit price of €4.91. 

Our offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This represents our best possible offer under the current market conditions. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership and supplying your needs from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised proposal. We always appreciate the opportunity to work with you and support your operations with our extensive inventory and dedicated service.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. If you require 90-day payment terms alongside a 36-month contract, our price must adjust to €4.94 per unit to account for the extended financing. Therefore, our offer presents a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We cannot offer further reductions on this package. 

For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

decisions.tactician: o6 gives the same lowest C as E0, and its two-year term speaks directly to the supplier's 'multi-year volume' condition. It is also less extreme than E0's 36 months, so it is more credible to a supplier that is reorganising its account list. The 12-month options cost us about €14.5k more in C. All options are worth about 16% less to the supplier than its own sheet, so a counter-offer is expected. The three arguments support the price push: weaker delivery, rising volume and the current price.

decisions.tactician: o3 and o4 have the lowest C after o8, and almost equal to it. o4 gives the supplier what it said it values, a multi-year commitment, which its 'to it' figure does not count, while costing us nothing extra. Dropping from ninety to sixty days payment is a visible concession that makes the counter credible and should speed its movement. E0 just repeats ninety days and twenty-four months, which it has already priced, so it adds nothing new. Accepting at €4.94 now leaves large value on the table with nine messages remaining.
